description: Shared journal verdict vectors read by runtime/ctr/test/test_results.py and packages/dartbrew/test/verdict_test.dart. lines are joined with newlines; observation is optional. expect.exit_code is the terminal exit_code the verdict carries (null when absent or when no verdict was reported).

cases.name: keepalive blank lines before and after
lines without the prefix are ignored
cleanup fail with terminal pass is contradictory
terminal assertion count other than one
host timeout does not change a pass
older run records before begin are ignored
malformed lines before begin are ignored
output record without text is an unknown event
several output records are collected in order
exit code 3 fails carrying the code
exit code 0 with failed cleanup fails
pass with a nonzero exit code is contradictory
incomplete with an exit code is contradictory
